_meta.road_scope: all motorway + trunk, every named expressway (SLEX/NLEX/SCTEX/Skyway/CAVITEX/TPLEX/NAIAX/CALAX/C5/EDSA/Commonwealth), and ref-bearing primary (PH national highways = alternate routes). Non-expressway link ramps and ref-less local primary streets are excluded to keep the layer mobile-sized.

_meta.disclaimer: Expressway segments intersecting the most recent Sentinel-1 observed flood extent as of 2026-06-21. Observed, not a forecast or routing instruction. For live road conditions use MMDA Flood Control, PAGASA, LGU DRRMO.
